title: fix(core): a signed-in request reads its session once with the rate limiter armed or a gate active on REST
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me
Fixes #35606
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么：开启了入站限流、或在数据接口上开启了登录策略门禁的部署里，一个已登录的请求只查一次会话（原来要查两到三次），响应更快；谁能访问、返回什么状态都不变。
- 为什么做：托管数据库上每查一次会话就是两次远程往返，同一个请求重复查纯属浪费；这是此前「门禁不再重复读会话」那次修复的后半段。
- 出错会怎样：如果共享出了错，一个请求可能用到稍早的会话判断；为此只在同一请求内共享，期间有任何写入、会话过期或查询失败都重新查，登录相关接口（组织的访问地址白名单在那里判断）一律自己重查；可以直接撤回，不涉及数据。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes

One request-scoped session-read carrier in core, in the shape of the request-grants memo, that the inbound rate limiter, the identity step of every door and REST's `reread-when-active` gate read through, so one signed-in request reads its session once.

- **`packages/core/src/security/request-session-read.ts` (new).** An `AsyncLocalStorage` scope (`openRequestSessionRead` / `withRequestSessionRead` / `withoutRequestSessionRead` / `readRequestSession`, exported from `@objectstack/core`). A stored read is served to a later reader of the same request only when: same auth session API object and every header equal (the read's input is decided by those headers); no engine write has landed or is in flight since the read opened (engine write epoch + the grants memo's write observer: `engineWriteMark` / `engineWritesQuietSince`, added to `request-grants-memo.ts`); the session has not expired. A read that throws is never stored, so each reader keeps its own outage answer. Served values are clones. A scope closes when its request settles; nothing survives a request.
- **`request-execution-context.ts`.** `resolveRequestExecutionContext` joins the scope open where it runs (or opens one for its own call), and its session arm (`readSession`) and `decideAuthGate` (`reread-when-active`) both read through the carrier. `readWriteEpoch` is now exported from its module for the carrier.
- **Runtime limiter.** `resolveSessionPrincipalId` / `resolveSessionData` read through the carrier with the engine the auth service reads through (`dispatcher-plugin.ts` passes `objectql`).
- **Hono transport (`adapter.ts`).** The middleware seam runs its chain in a scope of its own (the limiter's read) and hands that scope to the route it serves only when the route was registered through `IHttpServer` and every handler Hono ran between the seam and the route is a whole-server middleware (`matchedRoutes`, `/*`). A route behind a path-scoped middleware or a yielding route, and every raw-app route, read for themselves. Every request starts outside any scope (`withoutRequestSessionRead`), so a request served in process inside another never reaches the outer one's reads. The seam and the route now share one header reading (`readRequestHeaders`, `host` backfilled from the URL), so their keys agree.
- **Why an async scope and not a request-attached carrier:** the seam and the route each get their own request object built from the same request, and core's readers receive only `Headers`; nothing attached to either object reaches the other or core. The Hono context is used only to hand the seam's scope handle to the route of the same request (a `WeakMap` keyed by the context, deleted when the route answers).
- **Why the path-scoped rule:** plugin-auth's door under the auth base path is a middleware scoped to that path; it carries the request's address to the session reads behind it, and the organization's IP list is judged on those reads only (ADR-0069 D5). The limiter's read is made in front of that door, so it must never answer a reader behind it. The rule keeps it from crossing; pinned below on the real door.

Per door and posture, warm request, `getSession` / `sys_session` by token / `sys_user` by id, real kernel:

| Door · posture | origin/main `03865ae995` | this branch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (a) limiter armed · dispatcher `GET /api/v1/packages` | 2 / 2 / 2 | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| (a) limiter armed · REST `GET /api/v1/data/pin_note` | 2 / 2 / 2 | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| (b) gate active · REST | 2 / 2 / 2 | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| (b) gate active · dispatcher | 1 / 1 / 1 | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| (c) both · dispatcher | 2 / 2 / 2 | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| (c) both · REST | 3 / 3 / 3 | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| (d) default · dispatcher and REST | 1 / 1 / 1 | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| limiter armed · auth mount `GET /api/v1/auth/client-address` (control) | 2 | 2 (reads for itself behind the door) |

Who is admitted or refused, and with which status, does not change.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.session-read-once.pin.test.ts` (rewritten, real kernel: ObjectQL + sqlite-wasm + Hono + AuthPlugin + SecurityPlugin + REST + dispatcher; three kernels: gate, limiter, both). ⭐ one read on (a)(b)(c) for each door. CONTROLS: held session 403 with the posture code (both doors), revoked 401, anonymous 401 with no `sys_session` statement, concurrent requests with two tokens each get their own answer on one read each, limiter still keys by principal and refuses over budget (30 x 403 then 429 with `retryAfterSeconds`, decided on one read; another principal untouched), a failing read keeps its outage answer (REST 401 / dispatcher 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, never served), a failing limiter read is not served (route reads afresh), a revocation landing between the limiter's read and the route's is seen (401 both doors), and the auth-mount control above. 26/26 green at `655c4e2399`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/session-read-scope.pin.test.ts` (new, real Hono app): route past whole-server middleware is served the seam's read; a route behind a path-scoped middleware reads for itself inside that middleware's ambient state; a route behind a yielding route reads for itself; a raw-app route reads for itself; a request served in process inside a route reads for itself. 5/5.
- `packages/core/src/security/request-session-read.test.ts` (new): served/clone, isolation (no scope, other headers/API, interleaved scopes, continuation after close, join, handle across stretches, `withoutRequestSessionRead`), freshness (write landed, write in flight, non-write epoch bump, expired, throw not stored, unwatchable engine). 15/15.

<details><summary>Reverse verification and ablations (one-off; nothing left in the tree)</summary>

- At origin/main `03865ae995` (runtime/core/hono sources reverted, pin file kept) the final runtime pin file (26 tests) went 10 red / 16 green: every ⭐ and every one-read control red, e.g. `expected { getSession: 3, sys_session: 3 } to deeply equal { getSession: 1, sys_session: 1 }` on (c) REST.
- Admission check ablated (`seamReadsReachRoute` answering true), via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `0da067a3ecff` to `29dc9cac98bb`): the path-scoped-middleware and yielding-route pins go red (2 failed / 3 passed); restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Previous request-wide scope layout (adapter and carrier at `9244357e1a`, rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` confirming the marker absent from `plugin-hono-server/dist`): the auth-mount control goes red, `expected 1 to be 2` (the limiter's read answered the reader behind the door). Restored, hashes equal HEAD, rebuilt, preflight confirms the marker back in `dist/`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The carrier's guard against ambient read state is structural: a whole-server middleware (`use('*')`) registered after the seam that changed a session read's ambient state would defeat it. None does in the tree (the only such state is plugin-auth's door, path-scoped). Stated in the carrier's docblock.
- Conservative fallbacks, unchanged from origin/main: a dispatcher or REST route behind a path-scoped middleware or a yielding route, and every raw-app route (plugin-auth's mounts, the `/auth/me/*` endpoints), with the limiter armed, still read twice (limiter + route).
- A write from another process lands unobserved by the write observer: a later reader in the same request is served the session as of the request's first read, milliseconds earlier.
- New public exports from `@objectstack/core`: `openRequestSessionRead`, `withRequestSessionRead`, `withoutRequestSessionRead`, `readRequestSession`, types `RequestSessionRead`, `RequestSessionReadHandle`. Module-level exports (not re-exported from the index): `readWriteEpoch`, `engineWriteMark`, `engineWritesQuietSince`, `EngineWriteMark`.
- (d) default posture measured 1 / 1 / 1 at BASE and on this branch (both doors and the auth mount); the issue's premise does not name it as doubled.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`: `seamReadsReachRoute`, the middleware seam's scope (open, run chain, hand off, close after `next()`), and `sessionReadScopeForRoute` in `wrap`.
2. `packages/core/src/security/request-session-read.ts`: `readRequestSession` (serve rule, store rule) and the residuals in the docblock.
3. `packages/core/src/security/request-execution-context.ts`: the `joinRequestSessionRead` wrapper and the two consult points.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/http-dispatcher.session-read-once.pin.test.ts` → `Tests 26 passed (26)` (needs `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` built).
